title: ActiveEvidence: Decision-Focused Evidence Graphs with Verifiable Acquisition Gaps
abstract: arXiv:2610.20532v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A multimodal agent must decide whether visual evidence is worth acquiring, which candidate or resolution to query, and when further interaction can no longer change its decision. We study this problem under a strict free-metadata/paid-observation boundary, stochastic vector costs, and a frozen execution trace, and treat it as decision-certifiable active evidence acquisition. A Counterfactual Evidence Interaction Graph (CEIG) represents unary evidence value, signed second-order interaction, and directed conditional harm while maintaining explicit score enclosures for unresolved interactions; a decision-weighted enclosure objective tightens the bounds that can change action identity. Gap-directed refinement evaluates only interactions that can displace the incumbent acquisition and stops once an $\epsilon$-decision certificate shows that unresolved terms cannot change the selected action beyond a declared tolerance. translated_title: ActiveEvidence：具有可验证获取差距的决策导向证据图
translated_abstract: 多模态智能体必须决定视觉证据是否值得获取、查询哪个候选对象或分辨率、以及进一步的交互何时不再能改变其决策。我们在严格的免费元数据/付费观测边界、随机向量成本以及冻结执行轨迹的条件下研究这一问题，并将其视为可决策认证的主动证据获取问题。反事实证据交互图（CEIG）表示一元证据价值、带符号的二阶交互以及有向条件性损害，同时为未解决的交互维护显式的分数包络；决策加权包络目标收紧了可能改变动作身份的界限。间隙导向的细化仅评估能够取代现有获取方案的交互，一旦ε-决策证书表明未解决的项在声明的容差范围内无法改变所选动作，便停止评估。该证书是……
tldr: 该论文提出ActiveEvidence框架，通过反事实证据交互图（CEIG）和可验证的ε-决策证书，使多模态智能体能够高效决定何时获取视觉证据、仅评估可能改变决策的关键交互，并在证明进一步交互无法改变所选动作时及时停止。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes ActiveEvidence, which leverages counterfactual evidence interaction graphs (CEIG) and verifiable ε-decision certificates to enable multimodal agents to efficiently decide when to acquire visual evidence, evaluate only decision-relevant interactions, and stop once further interaction is provably unable to change the selected action.
